notes:
### New
- **Tidy finds missing album art.** The new Artwork section lists tracks whose
  file has no cover and searches iTunes, MusicBrainz and the Cover Art
  Archive for it by artist and title. Sure matches (**Exact**) are ticked,
  uncertain ones (**Maybe**) wait for you. Covers are shrunk to a baseline
  JPEG of at most 800 pixels and embedded in the file; each file is backed
  up first and every change can be undone. Engine DJ's library is updated
  too. For Rekordbox, select the tracks and choose Reload Tag to show the
  new cover (tested for tracks that had none; replacing an existing cover
  isn't confirmed yet). Only artist and title text is sent online.
- **Review artwork comfortably.** One scrollable list (Maybe first, then Exact,
  then not found; sortable by name or date added), live progress with Stop, a
  big preview of the cover beside the list, an option to tick the uncertain
  matches too, and a per-track "Search for…" for bootlegs.
- **Analyse several songs at once** (Settings → Analysis → Songs analysed at
  once). The starting value and the limit follow your computer's fast cores and
  memory (2 on a 4-fast-core Mac with 16 GB; more on bigger chips, fewer on
  small laptops), and fewer are used if memory is short. Two at once is about
  1.5× faster and four about 2×, at about 0.8 GB of memory each.
- **Tag lookup** (Tidy → Tag lookup) fills in album, year, label and genre
  from iTunes, Discogs and MusicBrainz. Only empty fields are filled by
  default, titles and artists are never touched, nothing is cleared, and you
  see every field before applying (undo in Backups).
- **Tidy works on OpenCrate's own library**, the default on every tab (Smart
  fixes, Genres, Artists, Health, Artwork, Tag lookup), or on a Rekordbox or
  Engine DJ library as before. Undo restores OpenCrate's own library too.
- **Faster Health check** (uses all CPU cores), and a **Stop** button while
  covers are being applied or shrunk.
- **Delete backups to free space.** The Backups tab shows each backup's size
  and the total, and lets you delete library backups and undo records (after
  asking), or keep only the newest few. Tidy and artwork changes now also trim
  old library backups like other changes do.
- **More places to find covers.** Artwork lookup now also checks your own
  computer first (a cover picture in the album folder, other tracks of the same
  album, Rekordbox's and Engine DJ's own copies), then iTunes, Deezer, Discogs
  (with your own free token, in Settings) and MusicBrainz. Each cover says
  where it came from. This computer, iTunes and Deezer are on by default (the
  fast ones); Discogs and MusicBrainz are slower, so you switch them on. Four
  tracks are looked up at once, and the screen shows what each source matched.
- **Add artwork found online without asking** (Settings, Tidy & backups): off
  by default; adds only Exact matches by itself, still backed up and
  undoable.
- **Shrink artwork** replaces covers that are too big, PNG, CMYK or
  progressive with a small baseline JPEG that players can read. It only ticks
  the ones that really get smaller or that players can't show; the rest are
  listed, unticked, with the reason.
